entities.name: Theft of Maha's Egg
entities.description: Event on Bloomburrow in 4564 AR when Cruelclaw stole Maha's egg.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: Great Night Owl whose egg was stolen.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: Weaselfolk mercenary who stole the egg.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: Ruler of Fountainport who ordered the theft.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Recovered the egg and returned it to Maha.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived following Jace's aether trail.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose aether trail Ral followed.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: Destroyed in the Calamity Beasts' rampage.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: Region the Calamity Beasts rampaged across.

events.summary: King Glarb hired Cruelclaw to steal Maha's egg to raise a Calamity Beast guardian.
events.quote: King Glarb, plagued by prophetic dreams of Valley’s destruction, hired Cruelclaw to steal Maha’s egg

events.summary: The theft provoked a rampage and the destruction of Pondside.
events.quote: leading to the destruction of Pondside and widespread chaos

events.summary: Ral Zarek met Mabel's party in Three Trees City.
events.quote: encountered Mabel and her companions in Three Trees City

events.summary: Glarb summoned Cruelclaw to eliminate the party, but Maha arrived and Mabel calmed her by returning the egg.
events.quote: Mabel was able to calm Maha by returning its egg

events.summary: Glarb and Cruelclaw escaped the city.
events.quote: Glarb and Cruelclaw both escaped the city in the aftermath

relations.quote: acting on the orders of King Glarb of Fountainport
